title: Lead, Agrifoods Systems - WAEMU
description: THE OPPORTUNITY Reporting to the Director, Entrepreneurship Development, the Lead, Agrifoods Systems will support the building of impactful country programs by setting direction and engaging partners throughout program design and implementation of the WAEMU Roadmap, WAEMU One Plan & Agrifood priorities within the WAEMU Roadmap. S/he will provide expertise to identify constraints that prevent agrifoods systems from functioning effectively at the country level and incorporating the agricultural sector’s needs into country strategies. WAYS YOU CAN CONTRIBUTE Provide agricultural sector expertise to support the Foundation country teams in the design and management of agricultural and Agri-finance programs. Identify challenges and opportunities in the agri-food systems to drive job growth. Collaborate with country teams and other team members in the development or implementation of new programs, including co-creation of programs and due diligence practices. Communicate progress and learnings from projects to the Foundation colleagues and the wider development community. Collaborate with the program and country teams to leverage synergies across programs, platforms and across geographies. Manage current programs, distilling learnings for the Foundation staff and country teams. Provide perspective and expertise on emerging issues and trends in the agricultural and Agri-finance sector, including climate change. Contribute insights to the Foundation’s thought leadership on youth employment in Africa. Lead and supervise teams of colleagues and/or junior experts by providing coaching and support necessary for success and growth. Identify and help overcome challenges and other barriers to team effectiveness. Build relationships with partner organizations, communities of practice, and global stakeholders. Represent the Foundation and collaborate with key internal and external audiences. WHO YOU ARE Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business, Agricultural Economics and/or Financial Inclusion. Minimum ten (10) years of relevant experience in financing agricultural companies and farmers is required. Minimum 5 years of leadership and management experience. Excellent project management skills, including multi-stakeholder projects. Experience working in commercial agricultural companies operational in Africa, West Africa, or WAEMU. Demonstrates a strong understanding of the role of financial inclusion in economic growth and development, particularly in Africa, and as it relates to smallholder farmers. Understands market and systemic challenges to financial inclusion for rural and agricultural economics in Africa and best practices for addressing them. Experience and understanding in a variety of value chains (cash and food crops), the small businesses and SMEs along the value chain, and supply chain / logistics in the agri-food system. Understanding of the role of agri-food and rural SMEs in economic transformation and job creation for youth. Demonstrates a strong understanding of agricultural markets in Africa and the systemic challenges leading to stagnant growth. Demonstrates strong analytical skills, the ability to think strategically and contribute as a thought partner in the Foundation’s strategy development. Demonstrates strong budgeting skills with the ability to manage a large portfolio of assets. Command of quantitative and qualitative business analytics. Flexible, adaptable, and able to execute a range of job duties and changing priorities. Proven excellence in verbal, written, and presentation skills with the ability to articulate information to a variety of constituents across cultures and to distill complex information and data into accessible conversation and written pieces. Possess professional maturity, sensitivity with different cultures, and impeccable integrity that exemplify the Foundation’s values. You have a commitment to Mastercard Foundation’s values and vision. The Mastercard Foundation values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the organization and we are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Completion of satisfactory business references and background checks are essential conditions of employment. title: Partner, Partner Engagement
description: THE OPPORTUNITY Reporting to the Head, Partner Stewardship, the Partner will support the design, coordination, and execution of a comprehensive Partner Stewardship and Accompaniment Framework across the Foundations portfolio. The role will serve as a key operational driver within the Partner Stewardship team, working across the pillars of the Partner Engagement Framework. The Partner will play a critical role in translating the Partner Stewardship strategy into practical, day-to-day delivery; coordinating accompaniment activities, supporting the design and rollout of partner engagement initiatives, and ensuring consistency and quality across all partner touchpoints. The role will work closely with internal teams, including Program Teams (Countries & other Platforms), Impact, Evidence & Learning, Strategic Insights & Program Performance, Programming Excellence, and external stakeholders including the Foundation Partners and accompaniment/institutional strengthening partners. THE ROLE Partner Accompaniment Coordination Support the design and rollout of Partner Accompaniment, including the Partner opt-in and onboarding process, Partner capacity assessments, and Capacity Action Plans (CAPs). Coordinate the delivery of accompaniment activities across Partner archetypes, regions, and themes, ensuring alignment with the Foundation’s accompaniment principles and values. Maintain and regularly update the Marketplace Directory of vetted capacity accompaniment providers available to Partner Coordinate the provision, monitoring and tracking of all capacity enhancement activities by various teams at the Foundation, ensuring all providers are aligned with the Foundation’s engagement and accompaniment framework. Partner Experience and Engagement Support the standardization of partner onboarding, engagement, and feedback processes to ensure a consistent and positive partner experience across the portfolio. Support the bi-annual Partner survey, coordinating data collection, analyzing feedback, and tracking the implementation of recommended actions. Monitor and help address partner experience incidents, escalating to the Head as required, and documenting learnings for continuous improvement. Maintain open communication with partners and support the gathering of feedback to build trust and improve partner experience over time. Frameworks, Tools, and Systems Support the development and maintenance of guidelines, frameworks, tools, and processes that underpin Partner Stewardship and Accompaniment, including the Partner Resource Hub, Partner Connect, and other digital engagement on the Daraja Platform. Research and implement lean, smart, and agile processes to enhance clarity, efficiency, and creativity in partner stewardship and accompaniment delivery. Track, document, and leverage learnings to improve partner engagement, support allocation, and program outcomes on an ongoing basis. Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning Support the monitoring and tracking of partner accompaniment outcomes across the portfolio, contributing to regular reporting to Foundation leadership. Support evidence generation, documentation of key learnings, and translation of insights into adaptive improvements to the accompaniment and overall Partner stewardship model. Promote a collaborative environment for partners to share knowledge, resources, and experiences to address common challenges and leverage learnings for improved performance Internal Capability and Coordination Support the building of partner stewardship capabilities of Foundation staff, ensuring engagement is consistent and responsive to evolving partner needs. Coordinate cross-functional engagement with Program Teams, Impact, legal, Finance, Program Performance, and other enabling functions to ensure coherence in partner stewardship delivery. Contribute to the positioning of the Foundation as a thought leader in partner engagement and accompaniment by supporting development of knowledge products, knowledge sharing and institutional relationship management. WHO YOU ARE University degree in development studies, business administration, social sciences, or a related field is required. Relevant certification in program management, organizational development is an advantage Minimum of Five (5) years of relevant experience in partner management, organisational development, capacity strengthening, or programme management, with demonstrated progression into roles of increasing complexity and responsibility. Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing capacity strengthening or accompaniment programmes across diverse organisational types including non-profit, private sector, academic, and public institutions. Experience working with and across African organisations and contexts, with a strong understanding of the diversity of the African development ecosystem. Experience in partnership management, process design, and stakeholder engagement across complex, multi-stakeholder environments. Familiarity with monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks and their application in partner accompaniment or programme quality contexts. Experience working across multiple geographies and cultural contexts, with the ability to adapt approaches to different organisational and regional realities – Added advantage. Competencies: Highly organised with strong coordination and project management skills; able to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously without losing attention to detail. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to translate data and partner feedback into actionable improvements. Skilled communicator and influencer: Able to engage confidently at all levels, from Foundation leadership and senior external stakeholders to Partners and Accompaniment Partners on the ground. Equally comfortable producing clear written communications, facilitating complex conversations, and navigating sensitive situations with discretion and professionalism. Critical thinker with an agile mindset; comfortable navigating ambiguity and responding to change with professionalism. Strong partnership mindset; able to build trusted relationships with partners and align stakeholders across different roles toward common goals. Familiarity with Foundation processes and policies yet unafraid to innovate and improve them. Skilled at cross-functional coordination and collaboration across technical and operational teams. Results-driven with a pragmatic approach to decision-making and a strong eye for detail. Experience working in complex, fast-moving environments with multiple internal and external stakeholders. Influencing without authority that enables coordination across Accompaniment Partners, internal Foundation teams, and other stakeholders without direct line authority over any of them. Comfort with ambiguity and adaptive management Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite and digital collaboration platforms. Possess professional maturity, sensitivity with different cultures, and impeccable integrity that exemplify the Foundation’s values Demonstrate a commitment to Mastercard Foundation’s values and vision. The Mastercard Foundation values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the organization and we are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Completion of satisfactory business references and background checks are essential conditions of employment. For more information and to sign up for the Foundation’s newsletter, please visit http://www.mastercardfdn.org/ Follow the Foundation on Twitter at MastercardFdn

title: Lead, Programming Excellence
description: THE OPPORTUNITY Reporting to the Head, Programming Excellence, the role will lead and coordinate programming excellence across programs. The role will be responsible for driving efficiencies, effectiveness, and quality assurance of overall end-to-end programming processes and partner experience. WAYS YOU CAN CONTRIBUTE Lead Foundation-wide programming processes, standards and capacity building strategies Coordinate with the various delivery platforms to support consistent quality in scaling of the Foundation’s programs to help generate dignified work for more young people. Oversee program management and implementation processes, policies, and guidelines (work in coordination/consultation with enabling functions to ensure enterprise cohesion) Manage the program implementation processes, policies, guidelines and standards ensuring quality, coherence and alignment of all program processes post final design and enhancement of IPIA to Programming for Impact Take ownership of guidelines, tools, processes, templates to ensure standardization in coordination and consultation with OE. Enhance & streamline programming processes, workflows, documents, tools and overall process turnaround time for positive partner experience Work with Program Finance to measure, monitor & track program processes for effectiveness and efficiencies Implement recommendations to enhance program processes Manage and govern revisions to all programmatic processes, policies, guidelines in coordination with core relevant cross functional departments. Monitor the implementation of program-wide processes, policies, guidelines and standards and d lead the development and implementation of changes to ensure continued coherence and alignment to the evolving programming needs. Identify and curate contents for the Program Academy to drive capability, effective onboard and learning within Programs Team Drive capability enhancement across Program teams through trainings, workshops & learning within the Program teams in coordination with P&C & Foundation Academy Work with P&C to embed program learning in programming processes WHO YOU ARE University degree, preferably in business administration or a related field is required; Masters Degree will be advantageous. Program Management experience Minimum of Ten (10) years of experience driving program delivery Two (2) years leadership and management experience in a multi-country environment in Africa, with a preference for private sector experience. Experience in partnership management, process design & program management within nonprofit organizations, international NGO’s and/or learning institutions is also helpful. Competencies: Mastery of Microsoft Office suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel). Strong coordination, project planning and program management skills. Advanced skills in process mapping and management Excellent organizational and prioritization skills; demonstrated attention to detail and ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously. Exposure to strategic systems thinking with an ability to understand and engage with stakeholders in different ecosystems and design programming that addresses root causes and critical needs. Substantive knowledge of key issues and emerging trends and barriers in youth and work across Africa. Excellent English written and spoken communication skills, proofreading skills with a high attention to detail. Strategic and critical thinker with strong Programmatic experience Strategy and planning experience. Skilled at cross-functional coordination and collaboration. Process improvement implementation experience. Familiarity with Foundation processes and policies yet unafraid to innovate and redefine them. Strong partnership mindset and able to align stakeholders across different roles toward common goals. Skilled communicator and influencer, from executive through to technical levels and external constituencies, know how to navigate ambiguous environments and are comfortable at managing up and beyond hierarchy. Excellent multi-stakeholder management skills with senior Foundation colleagues and senior levels of external stakeholders. Fosters a positive spirit of collaboration in a complex, and rapidly evolving environment. Results drive/orientation, an eye for detail and pragmatic decision maker. Possess professional maturity, sensitivity with different cultures, and impeccable integrity that exemplify the Foundation’s values. Demonstrate a commitment to Mastercard Foundation’s values and vision. The successful candidate will be based in any of our listed offices in Africa. The Mastercard Foundation values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the organization and we are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Completion of satisfactory business references and background checks are essential conditions of employment. title: Director, Programming Excellence
description: THE OPPORTUNITY The Director, Programming Excellence provides strategic leadership to embed consistent, high-quality, inclusive, and adaptive program delivery practices across the Foundation. This role drives the design and implementation of standards, processes, and systems that enable operational excellence in how we work with partners—from selection and onboarding, through implementation and learning, to offboarding. By aligning tools, policies, capacity-building efforts, and partner feedback mechanisms, the Director ensures the Foundation’s programming reflects our values of respect, co-creation, accountability, and continuous improvement. This role acts as the institutional custodian of the partner journey and the architect of a holistic programming framework that supports Country and Technical teams in delivering transformative outcomes for young people. Through deep collaboration with other enabling functions—including Strategy & Learning, Research, Foundation Academy, and Knowledge Management—the Director will ensure that programming excellence is not only a technical imperative, but also a cultural and relational one. WAYS YOU CAN CONTRIBUTE 1. Programming Standards, Processes, and Quality Assurance Develop, refine, and maintain the Foundation’s programming processes, standards, toolkits, and templates to ensure consistency, coherence, and alignment across platforms and countries. Lead quality assurance efforts across the partner lifecycle, from due diligence through implementation to exit, ensuring alignment with Foundation values and intended outcomes. Govern and manage revisions to programming policies, guidelines, and processes in collaboration with Program Operations and other Functional Excellence teams. 2. Partner Journey Management Oversee the end-to-end partner journey, ensuring that partner experiences—onboarding, accompaniment, collaboration, and offboarding—are structured, meaningful, and values-aligned. Develop partner journey indicators in collaboration with M&E and Program teams to assess and improve the partner experience. 3. Partner Engagement & Accompaniment Lead the design and execution of structured partner onboarding and offboarding experiences, ensuring a seamless and values-based transition across stages. Design partner accompaniment strategies and practices that reflect the Foundation’s enabling posture and principles of co-creation. 4. Capacity Building & Learning Identify capacity gaps and lead the design and rollout of training, workshops, and learning sessions to strengthen program management and delivery capabilities. Coordinate with Foundation Academy, KM, and Research teams to ensure knowledge is codified, shared, and translated into action within Country and Technical teams. 5. Partner Collaboration & Feedback Loops Lead mechanisms to capture and act on partner feedback, including surveys, reflection sessions, and other partner-led inputs. Facilitate communities of practice, peer learning exchanges, and collaborative spaces to foster mutual learning between partners and internal teams. 6. Operational Alignment and Change Leadership Ensure Programming Excellence principles are embedded into the Foundation’s operating model and Ways of Working (WoW) frameworks. Serve as a change leader, promoting adaptive delivery, continuous improvement, and accountability to results. Partner with Integrated Teams to ensure standardization, alignment, and responsiveness to field realities. WHO YOU ARE Master’s degree in Organizational Development, Education, Public Administration, Social Innovation, or a related field. Professional certifications in Facilitation, Project Quality Management, Learning Design, or Operational Excellence are an asset. 12 - 15 years of work experience in Planning, Strategy and/or Project/Program management in both the private and public sectors. Proven track record in strategic planning, portfolio management, and large-scale program implementation across multiple countries or functions. Deep experience managing operational systems, processes, and tools to drive program performance and governance. Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders, manage cross-functional stakeholders, and lead strategic initiatives with high degrees of complexity and ambiguity. Experience in designing and facilitating high-impact learning, planning, or review sessions involving diverse stakeholders. Strong knowledge of inclusive development principles and experience integrating gender, youth, or marginalized group lenses into operational frameworks. Systems Thinking: Ability to design scalable, integrated solutions that promote coherence and continuous improvement. Inclusive Leadership: Builds trust, invites multiple perspectives, and engages partners as co-creators. Execution Excellence: Balances high standards with pragmatism; skilled at managing complexity. Collaborative Influence: Works effectively across teams and functions; facilitates alignment and shared ownership. Learning Orientation: Embraces experimentation, reflection, and agility in service of impact. High emotional intelligence, professional maturity, and cultural sensitivity. Deep commitment to the Foundation’s mission, values, and youth-centered approach. A highly analytical problem-solver and critical thinker who can define root cause, evaluate alternatives and find solutions effectively. Service mindset for responsiveness to requests and striving towards becoming trusted business partners to drive common Foundation goals. A team player with strong self-direction balanced with a collaborative and creative approach, with the ability to work under minimal supervision. Agile, adaptable, and able to execute a range of job duties and changing priorities. Possess excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills with the ability to articulate information to a variety of constituents across cultures and support a culture of change. Possess professional maturity, sensitivity with different cultures, and impeccable integrity. Alignment and commitment to Foundation mission and values. Aptitude for and keen interest in learning new information design and communication technology. The Mastercard Foundation values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the organization and we are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Completion of satisfactory business references and background checks are essential conditions of employment.
